name: Entity IO
description: Export/Import entity data as JSON file.
project_description: Entity IO exports and imports Drupal content entities (node, taxonomy_term, user, media, block_content, comment, paragraph and referenced files) as portable JSON files. Export walks each entity's fields and recursively serializes referenced entities (with files embedded as base64), so a single export carries the entity plus its related content. Import re-creates or updates entities from that JSON, mapping UUIDs to local entities via a custom entity_io_storage table, showing a side-by-side diff before overwriting an existing entity, and optionally creating new revisions or attributing the change to a chosen user. Operation is via per-entity 'Export JSON' tabs/operations, revision-list export links, batch export forms, an admin import form, JSON API routes, and a set of Drush commands (entity-io:export, :import, :list, :import-folder, :clear-exports). Storage can be the public or private file scheme. Four optional submodules extend it: entity_io_queue (queued import/export), entity_io_webhooks (send exports on entity events via HTTP, email or FTP), entity_io_push (deploy entities to another configured Drupal site over Basic Auth) and entity_io_purge (clean up the export storage directory).
